name: Babbler Ads Connector
author: dtolstyi

sections.description:
Babbler Ads Connector is a WordPress plugin that integrates your website with Babbler Ads services allowing seamless ads placement and management in comments of your posts.

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Comment Management – Automatically processes and manages comments through AI
  • Smart Engagement – Helps maintain active discussions on your posts using automatic ads placement
  • REST API Integration – Seamless communication with Babbler Ads services
  • Comment Tracking – Monitors and tracks comment threads for better engagement
  • Secure Communication – Uses WordPress nonces and authentication for secure data exchange
  • Easy Configuration – Simple admin interface for managing settings

External Service Usage

This plugin connects to the Babbler Ads services (https://babbler-ads.com) to provide AI-powered comment engagement features. When you use this plugin:

  • Impersonated comment data from your posts is sent to Babbler Ads servers for processing
  • The service may generate AI-powered responses based on your configuration
  • Post titles and content may be transmitted to provide context for AI responses

Important Privacy Information:
– Review Babbler Ads’s Terms of Service: https://babbler-ads.com/wordpress-connector/terms-of-service
– Review Babbler Ads’s Privacy Policy: https://babbler-ads.com/wordpress-connector/privacy-policy
– Data is transmitted securely via HTTPS
– You must register for a Babbler Ads account to use this service

Use Cases

  • Keep comment sections active and engaging
  • Maintain community discussions on older posts
  • Provide timely responses to user comments
  • Encourage more user participation and corresponding advertisement revenue

Requirements

  • A Babbler Ads account
  • WordPress 6.2 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Active internet connection for API communication

Privacy Policy

Babbler Ads Connector connects your WordPress site to external Babbler Ads services. By using this plugin:

  • Comment content from your posts is transmitted to Babbler Ads servers
  • Post titles and content may be sent to provide context
  • User engagement data is processed by Babbler’s AI
  • No personally identifiable information (PII) is collected without user consent

For complete privacy details, review:
* Babbler Ads Privacy Policy: https://babbler-ads.com/wordpress-connector/privacy-policy
* Babbler Ads Terms of Service: https://babbler-ads.com/wordpress-connector/terms-of-service

Support

  • Documentation and Support: https://babbler-ads.com/wordpress-connector

Credits

  • Developed by Dmytro TOLSTYI
  • Uses WordPress REST API
  • Integrates with Babbler Ads Network
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Babbler Ads Connector”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. After installation, click “Activate Plugin”

Configuration

  1. After activation, go to Settings > Babbler Ads Connector
  2. Sign up for a Babbler Ads account at https://babbler-ads.com if you haven’t already
  3. Enter your Babbler Ads API token
  4. Configure your comment engagement preferences
  5. Save your settings
  6. The plugin will automatically start monitoring your posts and publishing related ads
sections.faq:
Do I need a Babbler Ads account?

Yes, you need to register for a Babbler Ads account at https://babbler-ads.com to use this plugin

What data does this plugin send to external services?

The plugin sends comment data, post titles, and post content to the Babbler Ads service for AI processing. This data is used to generate contextual responses and manage engagement but never stored or shared with third parties.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all communication with Babbler Ads servers uses HTTPS encryption. Review our Privacy Policy at https://babbler-ads.com/wordpress-connector/privacy-policy for more details.

Does this work with all WordPress themes?

Yes, Babbler Ads Connector works with any properly coded WordPress theme that uses the standard WordPress comment system.

Can I customize the AI responses?

Yes, you can configure various settings through your Babbler Ads dashboard to control how the AI generates responses.

Will this slow down my website?

No, the plugin works asynchronously and doesn’t affect your site’s front-end performance. All processing happens in the background via REST API.

How do I uninstall the plugin?

Simply deactivate and delete the plugin from your WordPress admin panel. All plugin data will be removed during uninstallation.

Where can I get support?

For support, please visit https://babbler-ads.com/wordpress-connector or use the WordPress.org support forums.
